images.alt: A cane basket of clutches and pouches each wrapped in cream tulle and tied with a red bow, with dark rose petals scattered on white fabric.
Clutches and pouches laid out in two rows on white fabric, each wrapped in tulle with a red ribbon, with dark petals around them.
A cane basket of embellished flat shoes, each wrapped in cream tulle and finished with a red bow.
Three grey suitcases dressed in long cream tulle and red satin ribbon, each topped with a deep red rose and dried flowers.
A heap of cream and gold satin drawstring pouches with rope handles, pearls and lace trim, on white satin.
A fan of henna cones tied with orange ribbon and labelled with gold stickers, beside a decorated coaster.
A spread of gifts: henna cones with orange ribbon, embroidered pouches, wrapped chocolates and satin bags.
